description: This file defines a JSON attribute converter for JPA entities, enabling automatic serialization and deserialization of JSON data to and from database columns using Jackson's ObjectMapper.

classes.name: JsonAttributeConverter
classes.description: A JPA attribute converter that serializes JsonNode objects to Strings for database storage and deserializes Strings back to JsonNode objects, leveraging Jackson's ObjectMapper.

methods.name: convertToDatabaseColumn
methods.description: Converts a JsonNode object to a JSON string for database storage.

methods.name: convertToEntityAttribute
methods.description: Converts a JSON string from the database back into a JsonNode object.
